claude.jsonl.rule: a tool_result block with is_error true (the JSON boolean), counted once per tool_use_id
claude.jsonl.api_error_rule: a type: assistant line with top-level isApiErrorMessage true (the JSON boolean), counted once per line uuid

codex.jsonl.rule: an item_completed item with status failed, or an exit_code that is a non-zero integer, counted once per item id
